hook_en: He is near to your broken heart. 🙏
reflect_en: David doesn't promise a life without afflictions, but he promises something better: the LORD is near to the brokenhearted and delivers the righteous from them all. As this week ends, whatever has worn you down, you can bring it to the God who stays close.
q_en: What has been weighing on your heart this week?
x_en: The LORD is near to the brokenhearted; He saves the contrite in spirit.
tiktok: The LORD is near to the brokenhearted 🙏 Psalm 34:18–20 — He delivers you from them all
yt_title: The LORD Is Near to the Brokenhearted | Psalm 34:18–20 #Shorts
li_open: Sometimes the most important thing a leader can do is stay close.
li_quote: The LORD is near to the brokenhearted; He saves the contrite in spirit.
li_body: God doesn't keep His distance from people who are hurting; He draws near. Leaders who notice the brokenhearted on their teams and in their churches, and take time to pray with them, reflect that same nearness in a way no program can.
hook_es: Él está cerca de tu corazón quebrantado. 🙏
reflect_es: David no promete una vida sin males, pero promete algo mejor: Jehová está cercano a los quebrantados de corazón y de todos ellos librará al justo. Al terminar la semana, lo que te haya cansado puedes entregárselo al Dios que se queda cerca.
q_es: ¿Qué ha pesado en tu corazón esta semana?
x_es: Cercano está Jehová a los quebrantados de corazón; y salvará a los contritos de espíritu.
key_es: Cercano está Jehová a los quebrantados de corazón
